text_zh: 「以铅为誓，以键为坛——初铭之路始于此。」
text_en: "In lead we swear, upon keys we kneel—the first inscription begins here."

text_zh: 「形不可变，律不可违——汝之手当如铁钳，汝之心当如凝铅。」
text_en: "Form unchanging, law unbroken—thy hand as iron, thy heart as molten lead."

text_zh: 「唯变者恒，唯流者存——让圣字在烈焰中重生。」
text_en: "Only change endures, only flow remains—let sacred glyphs be reborn in flame."

text_zh:
ORDER-001 · 消耗品编制

入会条件: 无。强制征募。
分级: 标准损耗品

标准编制键徒。按§4.2条例补充，无特殊授权。失联后编号回收再用。大部分在第III层内失联，少数抵达第V层。

备注: 最大的编制。也是唯一不需要申请的编制。
text_en:
ORDER-001 · Expendable Personnel

Entry Requirements: None. Mandatory conscription.
Classification: Standard Loss-Asset

Standard keybound operatives. Replenished per §4.2 regulations, no special clearance. ID numbers recycled after loss of contact. Majority lose contact within Layer III, few reach Layer V.

Note: Largest personnel classification. Also the only one requiring no application.

text_zh:
ORDER-117 · 铭刻誓门

入会条件: 第V层存活证明 + F-017无污染记录
分级: 高权限技术人员
神学立场: 形不可变，引擎当锁死

专精废铅甄别与圣字钉造册。持有者报告铭刻时'每一字母都有准确重量'。经长期观察，确有精密操控现象。所造经卷收容成功率较标准编制高████%。

备注: 与ORDER-344存在神学分歧，但按条例无冲突。
text_en:
ORDER-117 · The Order of the Graven Oath

Entry Requirements: Layer V survival proof + F-017 clean record
Classification: High-clearance Technical Personnel
Theological Position: Form Immutable, Engine Must Remain Locked

Specialize in lead-waste sorting and sacred slug cataloguing. Holders report that during inscription 'each letter carries precise weight.' Long-term observation confirms anomalous precision control. Their constructed codices show ████% higher containment success than standard personnel.

Note: Theological disagreement with ORDER-344 exists, but no regulatory conflict per standing orders.

text_zh:
ORDER-344 · 熔变誓门

入会条件: 第IX层接触记录 + 污蜡耐受测试通过
分级: ████ 特殊处理人员
神学立场: 顺应变形，与引擎共化

专精污蜡操控与铭文组重铸。D-████使用后报告'铅字在手中融化又重塑'。附带现象: 走廊内偶闻金属液体滴落声。重铸效果不可预测，但偶有超常表现。

备注: 该编制在§编号系统中无正式类别。按惯例继续运作。
text_en:
ORDER-344 · The Order of the Molten Verse

Entry Requirements: Layer IX contact record + Corrupted ichor tolerance test passed
Classification: ████ Special Handling Personnel
Theological Position: Embrace Transformation, Commune with Engine

Specialize in corrupted ichor manipulation and inscription recasting. D-████ reported after use that 'lead letters melt and reforge in my hands.' Associated phenomena: Occasional metallic dripping sounds in corridors. Recasting results unpredictable, but occasional extraordinary performance observed.

Note: This classification has no formal category in §numbering system. Continues operation per established precedent.
